sentences.text: A midwife in blue scrubs, face mask, apron and gloves leans over to check a newborn baby held by its mother, who is sitting in a hospital gown in a patient room at The Portland Hospital.
A sleeping newborn baby wrapped in a teal blanket with a colourful vehicle print lies on its mother's chest. A hand gently rests on the baby's back in what appears to be a maternity patient room.
A new mother in a hospital gown smiles as she looks down at her newborn baby, whose head is just visible at the bottom of the frame, in a patient room at The Portland Hospital.

Close-up of a sleeping newborn baby lying on its mother's chest while a staff member in blue gloves adjusts the baby's patterned clothing. The mother is in a hospital gown, with only her torso in frame.
